positiveRealRules.chart: At Z=0 the original implicit equation s-Z^2*s^(2h)-T=0 is s-T=0. Its certified unique root is Tsharp, so X=Rsharp^2/(2*Tsharp)=Xsharp.
positiveRealRules.nearestLift: copy_j is an integer floor. At the reconstructed center, floor(Yi_j-center_j+1/2)=floor(copy_j+1/2)=copy_j; the original local offset is exactly zero.
positiveRealRules.normalizedRadius: The positive square root sqrt(2*Tsharp*Xsharp) equals rawSlowR>0 by radiusSquareIdentity, so sqrt(Q)*Rsharp=r.
positiveRealRules.quadratic: sqrt(2)^2=2. Each displayed reconstruction residual is exactly (sqrt(2)^2-2)*lift_j/Dgeom.
positiveRealRules.radial: r=exp(log(radialCoordinate/Lambda^i)/dr)>0. Hence Lambda^i*r^dr=radialCoordinate exactly by the real exp/log inverse law.

definitions.D2: H_second/(h*(1+h)), with continuous extension at h=0

proof.convergenceClaim: Finite asymptotic enclosure only. The infinite moment series is not claimed to converge.
proof.remainder: After N terms, the sign is (-1)^N and the absolute remainder is at most the positive N-th term. Taylor remainder for (1+t)^(-a) has this sign and is bounded by (a)_N*t^N/N! for all t>=0; integrate against the complete positive gamma density.
proof.zeroParameterPolicy: Generic h=0 or z=0 means the analytic continuous extension of normalized coefficients. Actual-source h and z below are strictly positive and are never replaced.

proof.tailProof: On 0<=a<=1/8, the exponential tail after degree n is <=(8/7)*(1/8)^(n+1)/(n+1)!. Every subsequent arithmetic operation is outward rounded.

proof.alpha: Abar=1+f_delta/(h*f)+H_delta/(h*H). Both additions are nonpositive. Their magnitudes are<2^-34 and<=1/4, so1/2<Abar<=1. For u_j=f_delta^j/h or H_delta^j/h, differentiate u1/f and u1/H: Abar_delta is u2/f-h*u1^2/f^2, and Abar_delta_delta is u3/f-3h*u1*u2/f^2+2h^2*u1^3/f^3. The printed exact rational sums bound both factors and prove the2^67 reserve.
proof.heat: For the complete normalized density exp(-u)u^h/Gamma(1+h), |H^(j)(z)|/h <= j!*(j+1)! for j=1,2,3. The delta operator is z*d_z, giving the computed 2z,2z+12z^2,2z+36z^2+144z^3 bounds. H>=1-2hz>1/2. No infinite tail is omitted.
proof.negativeMode: For w_minus=a*r, its first normalized derivative is a[(q_i/(gL))*r+r_i/(gL)]. Its second is a[((q_i*q_j+q_ij)/(gL)^2)*r+(q_i/(gL))*r_j/(gL)+(q_j/(gL))*r_i/(gL)+r_ij/(gL)^2]. Under the separately source-bound r<=B^260/S,r_i<=B^6,r_ij<=B^14,q_ij/(gL)^2<=B^23/S,gL>=S/B^2 and|q_i/(gL)|<=2, their absolute values are<B^264/S<2^-560. Neither the initial layer nor q_ij is assigned zero.
proof.slopes: xi=Abar_delta/Abar has |xi|<2^68 and |xi_delta|<2^137. Write alpha=h*Abar and kappa=(1+u^-2)/3. For mu_T=Q(delta)/T, Q=(kappa-1/2)(alpha-h)+(kappa/2-alpha/(2(1+alpha)))*xi, the product and inverse rules give |Q|<2^69, |Q_delta|<2^139. mu_R=3/2-2kappa+(1-2kappa)h-2Q. For nu, |IA|,|IB|<1 and the exact c,d below give every delta or T first derivative<2^144<2^512. All factors1/T are<=2 and1/(1+alpha)<=1.
proof.step: On x=delta/2 in[3/32,5/32], g=-x^-2+(1-x)^-2 is increasing and g<-38. Since exp(g)<2^-38, sigma=exp(g)/(1+exp(g))<2^-38. Its exact logistic recurrence gives sigma prime<2^-26 and all three derivatives<2^64. Therefore f=1-h*sigma(delta/2)/256 has f>1/2 and |f_delta|/h<2^-35.
proof.transfer: Integrate the two coordinate derivatives along the rectangle segment from(delta,T)=(1/4,1) to the actual point. The error is<2*2^512*2^-16384<2^-15000. This transfers only smooth comparison coefficients; carrier floors, source Volterra solutions and old numerical jet values are not transported.

proof.accuracy: Each returned comparison coefficient interval includes its numerical anchor interval, a strictly positive displacement radius, and all outward rounding. The alpha/h and alpha_T/h divisions are analytic factorizations; no interval containing0 is used as a denominator.

identities.completeHeat: The checked full loss integrand plus full heat integrand equals the original Gamma density, so H=1-originalHeatLoss on the entire compactified improper interval. The new profile argument is exactly2/Xsharp.
identities.field: On the authenticated open terminal neighborhood every completed positive-order term and its finite derivatives vanish. Retaining the original slow multiplier s^(-A-1/2) and using the positive real power law gives F=exteriorAmplitude*(R^2/2)^(-1-h)*f(delta)*H(4T/R^2). AtZ=0,s=T, delta=log(Xb*2T/R^2), so delta_T=1/T,R*delta_R=-2.
identities.parity: The even original chart and full heat imply c_Z=d_Z=mu_Z=nu_Z=0 atZ=0. This comparison identity does not set the actual full-matrix epsilon/frame or negative-mode derivatives to zero.
identities.rayleigh: The private original frame gives N=(-1,0),gabs=-R*FR,lambda0^2=2F*(gabs-2F),gamma=-c0=lambda0/(2F)>0. Hence actualRayleighAlpha equals actualAlpha=-R*FR/(2F)-1=h*Abar. Original alpha_T equals(h/T)*Abar_delta; both exact derivative and factored bodies are retained.
identities.slopes: For frozen D_R=Rsharp*partial_R andD_T=partial_T, c_i=D_iF/F+D_ialpha/(2alpha),d_i=D_iFR/FR. The full damping identity gives mu_i=kappa*c_i-d_i/2. Define the transport comparison coefficient nu_i=IA*c_i-IB*d_i with IA=log2/3 andIB=log2/3-7/72. These are the limiting comparison integrals; the original finite-u integrals differ by the separate positive8/u^2 and64/u^2 bounds. The checked original field chain and quotient identities make the constructed source field functionals mu/nu equal the displayed factored formula roots. They do not identify nu with the exact finite-u or actual Volterra logarithmic derivative. This is a source-bound analytic identity, not an assertion that unsimplified AST nodes are equal.
identities.terminal: Original Xtail=XR*exp(start), Xb=XR*exp(end), end-start=3 and Xsharp>0 give y=log(Xsharp/Xtail)=3-delta. The actual square-seed step obeys sigma(1-x)=1-sigma(x), so original fo equals1-h*sigma(delta/2)/256; the original body itself is retained.
